title: Day Hike in Kananaskis Country
includes: Kananaskis Conservation Parking Pass $15 + tax/vehicle/day (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Please come prepared with a day pack, hiking shoes, 1.5 liters of water per person, snacks and clothing for mountain weather.
It can snow any day of the year in the mountains!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the wilderness of Kananaskis Country, just Southeaset of Banff National Park, a little known gem in the Canadian Rockies. During this private hike, enjoy the history of the mountain parks, it's geology, geography, flora and fauna. Looking for something off the beaten path? This is it. Specific hikes vary depending on weather, wildlife and seasons.
